edition.locus: Logos 14 opening: further likeness — as the Father has life

source_text: ΛΟΓΟΣ Ι∆ʹ. Πρότασις ὡς ἐκ τῶν Ἀρειανῶν. pass_b_english: Fourteenth discourse. Still on likeness, with “as the Father has life in himself” set forward. Life-in-himself language is shared so the Son is not a lifeless instrument.
